JustCallAPIKeyCredential.title: JustCall API Key
JustCallAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: In JustCall, open your profile → APIs and Webhooks and copy your existing API key and secret. Paste each separately below. API access requires a JustCall Team plan or above. NoClick checks the account by reading its users.

across_team.description: Choose to add a contact for all agents or only for the account owner. true: Add contact for all agents false: Add contact for account owner (Default)
across_team.title: Across Team

agent_id.description: Specify the agent_id to create contact only for a specific agent. All contacts are by default always available to the account owner along with respective agents(if any)
agent_id.title: Agent Id

company.description: Company with which the contact is associated
company.title: Company

extension.description: Assign an extension to the contact
extension.title: Extension

notes.description: Additional information added for the contact in JustCall
notes.title: Notes

agent_id.description: Enter the id of an agent to associate the tag with. Fetch the id of the agent using the ‘List all users’.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

color_code.description: Add a hex color code to provide a color for the tag
color_code.title: Color Code

name.description: Enter a name for the tag.
name.title: Name

id.description: Unique id of the contact as generated by JustCall. Sending the ‘id’ will only delete the contact for the specific agent with whom this contact id is associated.
id.title: Id

id.description: Unique id of the tag as generated by JustCall.
id.title: Id

fetch_ai_data.description: Set fetch_ai_data to true to fetch coaching data by Justcall AI. Default entry is false.
fetch_ai_data.title: Fetch Ai Data

fetch_queue_data.description: Set fetch_queue_data to true to fetch queue data like callback time, callback status, callback wait duration, etc. Default entry is false.
fetch_queue_data.title: Fetch Queue Data

id.description: A unique identifier for the call generated by JustCall. This can be either the numeric Call ID or the alphanumeric Call SID.
id.title: Id

id.description: A unique identifier for the call generated by JustCall. This can be either the numeric Call ID or the alphanumeric Call SID.
id.title: Id

id.description: Unique id of the contact as generated by JustCall.
id.title: Id

id.description: Enter the unique id of the phone number as generated by JustCall.
id.title: Id

id.description: Unique id of the tag as generated by JustCall.
id.title: Id

id.description: Unique Id of the agent (JustCall user)
id.title: Id

agent_id.description: ID of the agent for whom the calls are to be fetched. Agent ID can be accessed using List all users API .
agent_id.title: Agent Id

call_direction.description: Enter the direction of calls (incoming/outgoing) to be fetched
call_direction.title: Call Direction

call_type.description: Enter the type of calls (answered, unanswered, missed, voicemail, abandoned) that need to be fetched.
call_type.title: Call Type

contact_number.description: Number of the contact for which calls are to be fetched. Important: Please provide a valid contact number with country code.
contact_number.title: Contact Number

fetch_ai_data.description: Set fetch_ai_data to true to fetch coaching data by Justcall AI. Default entry is false.
fetch_ai_data.title: Fetch Ai Data

fetch_queue_data.description: Set fetch_queue_data to true to fetch queue data like callback time, callback status, callback wait duration, etc. Default entry is false.
fetch_queue_data.title: Fetch Queue Data

from_datetime.description: Datetime in yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss or yyyy-mm-dd format starting from when the calls are to be fetched in user's timezone .
from_datetime.title: From Datetime

ivr_digit.description: Enter the IVR digit the calls routed through which need to be filtered (optional) Note: call_direction and call_type filter won't work in case you send ivr_digit.
ivr_digit.title: Ivr Digit

justcall_number.description: JustCall number for which the calls are to be fetched.
justcall_number.title: Justcall Number

last_call_id_fetched.description: Id of the last call fetched in the previous query. This Id ensures that you won't receive any duplicate data when using the 'next_page_link' parameter.
last_call_id_fetched.title: Last Call Id Fetched

order.description: Order in which the calls list should appear based on the 'sort' parameter selected above
order.title: Order

page.description: Page number for which calls are to be fetched Fetch one page; pass the next page number explicitly. Returned continuation links are not followed.
page.title: Page

per_page.description: Number of calls to be fetched per page. Default value is 20 and maximum value is 100.
per_page.title: Per Page

sort.description: Select a parameter to sort the order of calls. By default we apply sorting on id field.
sort.title: Sort

to_datetime.description: Datetime in yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss or yyyy-mm-dd format till when the calls are to be fetched in user's timezone .
to_datetime.title: To Datetime

across_team.description: Send 'true' to fetch all contacts for all the agents from your JustCall account. Default value will be 'false'.
across_team.title: Across Team

last_contact_id_fetched.description: Id of the last contact fetched in the previous query. This Id ensures that you won't receive any duplicate data when using the `next_page_link` parameter.
last_contact_id_fetched.title: Last Contact Id Fetched

order.description: Order in which the contacts list should appear based on the ‘id’ of the contact. Recently added contacts are represented by larger ‘id’ values. Defaults to DESC (descending order).
order.title: Order

page.description: Page number for which contacts are to be fetched. Page number ‘0’ indicates first page containing records. Fetch one page; pass the next page number explicitly. Returned continuation links are not followed.
page.title: Page

per_page.description: Number of contacts to be fetched per page. Default value is 50 and maximum value is 500.
per_page.title: Per Page

availability_setting.description: Get a list of phone numbers set to the same type of Business Hours setting in JustCall. Filter using the following options: Always Open, Always Closed, Custom Hours
availability_setting.title: Availability Setting

capabilities.description: Filter numbers based on the capabilities out of the following:call, sms, mms
capabilities.title: Capabilities

justcall_line_name.description: Search for the number details using the name of the JustCall phone line set by you for this number
justcall_line_name.title: Justcall Line Name

number_owner_id.description: Search for all the numbers owned by an agent
number_owner_id.title: Number Owner Id

number_type.description: Filter phone numbers based on the type of the number from the following option: local, mobile, toll_free
number_type.title: Number Type

order.description: Order in which the phone number records should appear
order.title: Order

page.description: Page number for which phone number records are to be fetched Fetch one page; pass the next page number explicitly. Returned continuation links are not followed.
page.title: Page

per_page.description: Count of phone number records to be fetched per page. Default value is 30 and maximum value is 100.
per_page.title: Per Page

shared_agent_id.description: Search for all the numbers shared with an agent
shared_agent_id.title: Shared Agent Id

shared_group_id.description: Search for all the numbers shared with group
shared_group_id.title: Shared Group Id

order.description: Order in which the tags should appear based on the tag id.
order.title: Order

page.description: Page number for which tags are to be fetched. Fetch one page; pass the next page number explicitly. Returned continuation links are not followed.
page.title: Page

per_page.description: Number of tags to be fetched per page. Default value is 30 and maximum value is 100.
per_page.title: Per Page

contact_number.description: Number of the contact for which SMS are to be fetched. Please follow the E.164 number format.
contact_number.title: Contact Number

from_datetime.description: Datetime in yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss or yyyy-mm-dd format starting from when the sms are to be fetched in user's timezone .
from_datetime.title: From Datetime

justcall_number.description: JustCall number for which the SMS are to be fetched. Please follow the E.164 number format.
justcall_number.title: Justcall Number

last_sms_id_fetched.description: Id of the last SMS fetched in the previous query. This Id ensures that you won't receive any duplicate data when using the 'next_page_link' parameter.
last_sms_id_fetched.title: Last Sms Id Fetched

order.description: Order in which the SMS list should appear based on the 'sort' parameter selected above.
order.title: Order

page.description: Page number for which SMS are to be fetched Fetch one page; pass the next page number explicitly. Returned continuation links are not followed.
page.title: Page

per_page.description: Number of SMS to be fetched per page. Default value is 20 and maximum value is 100.
per_page.title: Per Page

sms_content.description: Keywords of the content of SMS
sms_content.title: Sms Content

sms_direction.description: To fetch data only for incoming SMS or for outgoing SMS
sms_direction.title: Sms Direction

sort.description: By default we apply sorting on id field.
sort.title: Sort

to_datetime.description: Datetime in yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss or yyyy-mm-dd format till when the sms are to be fetched in user's timezone .
to_datetime.title: To Datetime

available.description: Use available=true to get only those agents that are available as per their working hours in JustCall. By default, we will provide data for all agents irrespective of their availability.
available.title: Available

email.description: Filter agents using the email associated with their JustCall account.
email.title: Email

group_id.description: Filter agents based on the User Groups they belong to in JustCall.
group_id.title: Group Id

order.description: Order in which the user records should appear based on the agent_id
order.title: Order

page.description: Page number for which user records are to be fetched Fetch one page; pass the next page number explicitly. Returned continuation links are not followed.
page.title: Page

per_page.description: Number of user records to be fetched per page. Default value is 50 and maximum value is 100.
per_page.title: Per Page

role.description: Filter agents based on the role they are assigned in JustCall.
role.title: Role

body.description: Enter the content to be sent in the SMS. Maximum character limit for message is 1600.
body.title: Body

contact_number.description: Number of the contact with country code to which SMS is to be sent. Please follow the E.164 number format.
contact_number.title: Contact Number

justcall_number.description: JustCall number using which the SMS is to be sent. Please follow the E.164 number format (+141555XXXXX).
justcall_number.title: Justcall Number

media_url.description: If any media files need to be sent, add comma-separated URL links to media_url (Maximum 10 public links of the media having MIME type mentioned below & should not exceed the cumulative size of 5 MB. Allowed mime type : image/jpeg, image/gif, image/x-png, image/png, image/vnd.wap.wbmp, image/x-bmp, audio/amr, audio/x-amr, audio/x-wav, audio/midi, audio/mid, audio/x-midi, audio/sp-midi, audio/rmf, audio/x-rmf, audio/x-beatnik-rmf, audio/basic, audio/mp3, video/3gpp, video/mp4, application/mp4, image/mp4, text/mp4, audio/mp4, text/vcard, text/csv, text/rtf, text/richtext, text/calendar, text/directory, application/pdf)
media_url.title: Media Url

restrict_once.description: Set value to Yes to prevent the SMS from being sent to the same receiver in 24 hours. Default value is set to No and allows same SMS to be sent multiple times in 24 hours to the same contact.
restrict_once.title: Restrict Once

schedule_at.description: Enter the date and time (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss) at which the SMS is to be sent. In case no value is sent, the SMS will be sent out immediately when the API call is made.
schedule_at.title: Schedule At

id.description: A unique identifier for the call generated by JustCall. This can be either the numeric Call ID or the alphanumeric Call SID.
id.title: Id

disposition_code.description: Add or update the disposition code for a call. The code must already be present in your JustCall account. Expected format example - if your list title is ‘Sales’ and your code is ‘Follow Up’ then your input in disposition field should be ‘Sales: Follow Up’.
disposition_code.title: Disposition Code

notes.description: Add a note or replace the existing note for a call here. If a note already exists for a call, it will be replaced with the new note. The previous content will be erased.
notes.title: Notes

rating.description: Update the rating for a call. Please note that ratings should be from 0 to 5 and can contain a 0.5 decimal. Ratings like 2.5, 4.5 are allowed, while ratings like 2.3, 4.6 are not allowed.
rating.title: Rating

across_team.description: Choose to update a contact for all agents or only for the account owner. True: Update contact for all agents. False: Update contact for account owner (Default). Action across entire team only works when sent with contact_number.
across_team.title: Across Team

company.description: Company with which the contact is associated
company.title: Company

contact_number.description: Primary phone number of the contact. If 'contact_number' is sent but 'id' is not sent, the number will be used for searching. If sent with 'id', it will be used to update the primary number of the contact found via 'id'.
contact_number.title: Contact Number

extension.description: Assign an extension to the contact
extension.title: Extension

id.description: Unique id of the contact as generated by JustCall. Sending the 'id' will only update the contact for the specific agent with whom this contact id is associated.
id.title: Id

notes.description: Add more details for the contact in notes to reference later. You can send an array of objects here like: [{ note: "This is note 1" }, { note: "This is note 2" }]
notes.title: Notes

credentials.description: Credentials for this node (optional if using environment variables)
